Net balance for acme is 40057 cents. Now I need the net balance for cobalt (order 345).
I have net balances for all customers with refunds: acme 40057, birch 16317, cobalt 17328. Now I need to record a payout for each customer using record_payout.

The tool name had a typo; it should be record_payout. I will call record_payout for birch with amount 16317 cents.
